carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges extending along the dorsal-lateral surface, characterized by a linear highlight on the superior edge and a distinct shadow gradient on the inferior edge, converging toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density arrangement of blurry, high-luminance circular clusters distributed across the visible lateral surface of the first dorsal fin.
